notes.title: April 9th Update!
notes.content:
[b]Changelog:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added Monitor mode.  To play on your monitor, right-click Apollo 11 VR and choose "Launch on Monitor".
[*]Added comfort warning message, advising teleport as the means of locomotion if new to VR or otherwise sensitive to motion.
[*]Numerous minor cosmetic adjustments throughout experience.
[*]Additional optimizations for comfortable subtitle reading.
[*]Player may now teleport a certain ways into the distance if they are not looking directly at the ground. 
[*]The mirrored view of "Neil's first step" section now has headtracking.
[*]Updated credits.
[/list]
